rule: Sam, 2026-11-17, relayed by COBIx on #3358 section 2: collect with gaps noted and confidence scores; Commons Clarity's Part B (#3480, comment 6967374303); COBIx's D2 decision (major total differs, about 30); Sam's routine prompt of 2026-11-25, as the S739 conductor's brief carries it: a record held for a gap is collected with its gap named and a lower score on the 0-100 bar, never held, unless the record is not the program's own; S739: Butte's records kb/receipts/program_requirement_records_piles_s721_butte_2026-11-24_s721e.json held, read again by key: passed by a rescore where today's scorer's one reading moves them, else collected with their gaps named where the record is the program's own (no reread, no reconcile)

gaps.required_list_outside_total: The catalog prints a list the program requires apart from its printed total, and the record counts that list; without it the courses add to the printed total.

held.why: held: the major adds up, and the degree's 60-61 falls short of the map's 62-69; the map's 2-unit Graduation Requirement line closes the low end only, and Butte's reconcile step keeps that line out by S636's call; no kind's sentence is true of a sum below its printed range
held: an incomplete read (the requirements table is not in the text read; HELD_INCOMPLETE), on a page read for 43185 too, whose section heading names program code 43185: the own-section guard

records.words: The map lists AGS 20 and AGS 40 within List A, whereas the requirements list them as a separate 'Select one'; the requirements section was followed. | The 23.00 printed beside 'Required courses:' and 'Total : 23.00' is the major total; recorded as total_units, not as the first block's stated total.

outcomes: Accumulate, record, and analyze agricultural financial statements.
Analyze specific markets to explain and predict changes in price and economic behavior.
Demonstrate core management principles and apply them to different working scenarios.
Apply core marketing principles to the unique structure of the agriculture sector.
Demonstrate effective verbal and written communication in an agricultural business environment.
Recognize consumer and producer responsiveness to changing market conditions.

representation: checks.gaps and checks.confidence added as the load reads the filed score (a passing row: checks.arithmetic to equal); checks.coverage, invented and the record unchanged
claim_check_reads: Today's capture (sources.json): every course an entry names among the codes it found, and a course an entry says the printed total leaves out on neither it nor the state's list. A note's quoted figures are the reader's words, never re-read here.
follow_verdict: The follow_verdict trigger marks a row checked when its latest verdict is a confirm whose fingerprint matches the record and the machine checks pass. The record is unchanged here, so such a confirm on a row this plan moves to passing would check it at the apply, and the rollback would skip it. The pre-read counts those rows (confirm_matches); the apply aborts, writing nothing, unless the count is 0.
